headline: Nevish Line Clashes Escalate as Weathered Expanse Yields to Warden Sweep
war_summary: Combat over the past three hours shifted violently to the Nevish Line, where an erupting storm of nine base exchanges left the sector divided between five Colonial holdings, one Warden stronghold, and two abandoned tracts amidst over three thousand fresh casualties. In the Weathered Expanse, where chaos previously reigned, Colonial forces have now been cleared entirely from the map, leaving seven bases under Warden control and two in neutral desolation as direct ownership transfers halted. Further south, Linn of Mercy reignited with two base transactions and heavy slaughter exceeding thirty-five hundred combined dead in two hours, churning around Rotdust and Outwich Ranch. An aggressive push on the Stlican Shelf broke the stalemate as Warden units seized Briar, logging three transactions and over twenty-six hundred casualties. Meanwhile, Callahan's Passage and Mooring County settled into bloody stalemates with no base movements reported over the last two hours, though infantry exchanges remain punishing.
